acceptedArchitectureBasis: architecture-r3 performance criteria: measure equivalent coverage, source calls/bytes, exact revision invalidation before choosing caching/indexes. Existing code/data/native owners remain unchanged.

measuredBaseline.scope: Synthetic production service measurement, not native/DB/network latency or the older private saved-MCP48->11 comparison.

proposedTreatment.kind: Bounded process-local reuse of an immutable fully reconstructed/rendered report basis; optional source-owner composition setting, disabled by default.
proposedTreatment.storageOwner: Existing Workbench report-service instance; no shared harness/context store, source originals, repository data files, DB writes or native session mirror.
proposedTreatment.sourceOwner: Canonical Education query/strict reader/validator remains unchanged; authenticated fetchPage remains source-owner supplied and must run on each report request.
proposedTreatment.initialRequest: Use canonical reader to exhaust/verify every source page and final document digest; render complete immutable lines with original clocks/provenance. Retain only bounded report basis if enabled and policy allows.
proposedTreatment.continuationRequest: Qualify source module identity and obtain an authenticated canonical first-page read under the exact selector. Use the canonical strict wire validator and source-backed identity/budget rules. Reuse only if source snapshot, caller binding, selector/format/report identity and applicable metadata still match the verified basis.
proposedTreatment.authorization: A cursor or cache hit never authenticates the caller. Authenticate/qualify through owner callback before returning cached content; caller/snapshot changes or source refusal stop without cached disclosure.
proposedTreatment.integrity: Preserve original full-reader digest basis; verify fresh first-page identity/content/coverage as appropriate without replacing canonical wire validation. Source currentness stays unknown; hash equality of retained state is not LMS refresh or native authentication proof.
proposedTreatment.clocks: Keep teacher-reported/source-observed/verified/recorded/original-retrieved clocks unchanged. Label any latest retained-snapshot qualification clock separately.
proposedTreatment.unavailability: Expired/evicted/missing basis or drift produces a bounded explicit refusal, no silent skipped rows, invented completion, automatic effect retry or authority escalation. Preserve source-only stateless behavior when option disabled; any capacity fallback must be explicit and coverage-preserving.
proposedTreatment.dataBounds: Owner-controlled bounded entry count, TTL and serialized retained-report byte budget, enforced per instance; no RSS/secure-erasure claim. No real private data is accessed in this source task.
proposedTreatment.outputBounds: Same complete CallToolResult<=512KiB and requested report page budget, full continuation and Unicode/no-loss; JSONRPC frames separately measured, no universal512KiBframecap.

expectedMetric.formula: N canonical pages for initial full read + one authenticated retained-source qualification per remaining report page
expectedMetric.meaning: Must compare equivalent exact report lines/identities/clocks/stages and actual page counts; no native latency claim.

predeclaredValidation.methodOwner: Existing common constrained-improvement v1 scalar-efficiency helpers, pinned source; no new evaluator/store/native runner.
predeclaredValidation.protocol: Before candidate, create owning Work Input with target, useful goal, independent mandatory quality gates, allowed paths, bounded attempts/time and next decision; run canonical preflight.
qualityGates: All four007repairs plus existing16selectedSDK/report regressions remain satisfied
Normalized full report lines/reportHash and teacher/source metadata match stateless control under same fixture/source/environment

Fresh owner/source checks occur for every reused continuation; revoked/changed actor, wrong selector, snapshot/decision/cancellation/issuance revision, malformed/refused source and source-module drift disclose no cached output
Expired/evicted/over-budget basis, restart/new instance, Unicode/escaped data, small page budgets and forged/replayed selectors/cursors remain bounded with explicit continuation/refusal
No source/domain reducer, common schema, credential, global/native config, private file or source-original change
predeclaredValidation.efficiencyCriterion: Predeclare an absolute reduction goal in canonical source fetch calls on paired cases; only compare after required quality gates pass. Preserve full per-case counts/output pins and distinguish optional unmeasured time/cost.
predeclaredValidation.independentReview: Astra/xhigh design advisory before code; exact candidate re-review and source/semantic-transition validation before downstream CON03.

limits.stop: Any custody/permission/history/quality regression, unsupported native/auth assumption or absence of comparable complete evidence -> repair/defer/stop; no raising limits to manufacture success.

approvalBoundary.sourceImplementation: Within approved owner-local consumer/performance scope after qualified design and current repair review; no new owner/common/native effect.
approvalBoundary.activation: Held. Default disabled; native/source owner must separately qualify actual authentication/freshness and choose retention policy before enabling with real data.
approvalBoundary.privateData: Source tests invented only; no student originals copied or read.
approvalBoundary.acceptance: An efficiency accept proposal is not formal AcceptanceDecision, merge, deployment, native activation or teacher acceptance.

nextDecision: Independent reviewer assesses whether the bounded optional design preserves current custody/authentication and exact report meaning; Root then admits a distinct source Task or retains the measured gap/proposal without claiming improvement.
